# 52N34S — Steffen Giebler

> Solo founder and software developer in Berlin Mitte. Builds own
> apps and turns founders' ideas into shipped products.

## Products
- [Orivela](https://orivela.app): Personal records vault for iOS
  and Android. Documents, contracts and subscriptions, searchable
  in plain language.
- [Kolibi](https://kolibi.app): AI photo calorie tracker for iOS
  and Android. One photo per meal.
- [Peeranimo](https://peeranimo.app): Peer-matching social
  platform on the web.
- [Carpincho](https://carpincho.app): Spanish learning app,
  1,000 high-frequency words, three regional variants. Waitlist.
